browser.title: Sign in to Amazon
browser.description:
1. [Open the Amazon sign-in page]({url}) and sign in as usual (passkey, two-step verification and captcha all work).
2. When you land on a blank or "page not found" page, copy the full address from the browser's address bar.
3. Paste it below.

data_description.url: The whole address, starting with https and containing the authorization code.

discovery_confirm.description: {name} was found on your network. Do you want to connect your Amazon account to Home Assistant?

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Amazon no longer accepts the stored session. Choose how to sign in again.

data.enable_local: Probe devices on the local network

data_description.scan_interval: Only a fallback while push is connected. When push is down the account is polled every 60 seconds.
data_description.enable_push: Volume, playback, do not disturb, alarms and voice commands arrive as they happen.
data_description.enable_local: IP address, local reachability and Spotify user, read from the device itself every 60 seconds.

device_id.description: The device that receives the command.

device_id.name: Device

device_id.name: Device

call_feature.description: Advanced: calls a feature operation of an Alexa endpoint directly.
